}

}

zin_realm_crown_may_be_contested = {
	# G3: a contested crown splits the realm only when it is large enough and a dynamic tag is likely free (the S12 budget, counted here).
	num_of_controlled_states > 3
	has_capitulated = no
	has_civil_war = no
	check_variable = { global.zin_realm_contested_crowns < 12 }

zin_realm_is_story_ruler = {
	# G1 to G4 exemption: a canon figure or a story ruler leads, or the realm's rulers are a story mechanic's (the Aenor court, the Worshipdom,
	# Volgan, Zol).
	OR = {
		has_country_leader = { character = AEN_zin_ruler ruling_only = yes }
		has_country_leader = { character = zin_aurevan ruling_only = yes }
		has_country_leader = { character = zin_lorien ruling_only = yes }
		has_country_leader = { character = zin_volgan ruling_only = yes }
		has_country_leader = { character = zin_zol_will ruling_only = yes }
		has_country_leader = { character = NET_zin_ruler ruling_only = yes }
		has_country_leader = { character = zin_eindil ruling_only = yes }
		has_country_leader_with_trait = zin_trait_ancient_king
		zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
		original_tag = WOR
		original_tag = PUV
		original_tag = ZOL
	}
}
zin_realm_match_may_reign = {
	# G3: the house we married into can offer a prince.
	has_variable = zin_realm_match
	var:zin_realm_match = {
		exists = yes
		has_capitulated = no
		NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
	}
}
zin_realm_may_answer_kin = {
	# G7: we can go to war beside our kin.
	has_capitulated = no
	event_target:zin_realm_kin_foe = { exists = yes }
	NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:zin_realm_kin_foe }
	NOT = { is_in_faction_with = event_target:zin_realm_kin_foe }
}
zin_realm_may_marry = {
	# G7: a people that makes royal matches.
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = zin_realm_kin_men
		has_country_flag = zin_realm_kin_elves
		has_country_flag = zin_realm_kin_giants
		has_country_flag = zin_realm_kin_dwarves
		has_country_flag = zin_realm_kin_orcs
	}
}
zin_realm_may_pledge = {
	# G7: the match may be sealed with a guarantee (not where a story mechanic owns the bonds of either house).
	NOT = { zin_realm_alliance_owned = yes }
	event_target:zin_realm_match_answer = {
		exists = yes
		NOT = { zin_realm_alliance_owned = yes }
	}
	NOT = { has_guaranteed = event_target:zin_realm_match_answer }
}
zin_realm_mortal = {
	# G1: the ruler ages. On the historical path tier A rulers and the courts the chronicle names never die of age; a story realm's ruler
	# never dies of age while its beat is pending.
	NOT = { zin_realm_is_story_ruler = yes }
	NOT = { zin_realm_story_pending = yes }
	# NOT is a NOR (wiki, Triggers), so the pair is held in an AND.
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			OR = {
				zin_realm_tier_a = yes
				zin_realm_story_court = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_realm_pointless_war = {
	# G6, scope: an enemy country, PREV the realm at war. The war is pointless after the false god's death against a court of the East, or
	# after a year and a half against a foe neither side can reach, when no story owner ends it. Reads the temporary zin_t_purpose.
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead
			has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { zin_realm_story_war_side = yes }
			PREV = { NOT = { zin_realm_story_war_side = yes } }
			NOT = { is_neighbor_of = PREV }
			PREV = { NOT = { check_variable = { zin_realm_war_months < zin_t_purpose } } }
		}
	}
}
zin_realm_story_court = {

		original_tag = SEL
		original_tag = GIR
	}

zin_realm_story_pending = {
	# Story realms whose beat is pending (data/realm_life.json crisisPending, those with an end): Mirolon's watch and Gala's court, among others.
	OR = {
		AND = {
			zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_path_cp06_done }
		}
		AND = {
			original_tag = GAA
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_path_cp23_done }
		}
		AND = {
			original_tag = MIR
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_path_cp15_done }
		}
	}
}
zin_realm_story_war_side = {
	# G6: a party whose wars a story owner ends (the court of Aenor, the Deliverer's seat, the dark powers and their sworn realms, Mirolon,
	# Gala, Selen, the Grey Ford pair, Lerendor, the heir's host, and the clients of the East while the false god lives).
	OR = {
		zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
		original_tag = WOR
		original_tag = PUV
		original_tag = ZOL
		original_tag = MIR
		original_tag = GAA
		original_tag = SEL
		original_tag = GNW
		original_tag = GIR
		original_tag = LER
		is_subject_of = PUV
		is_subject_of = ZOL
		AND = { has_character = zin_eindil has_global_flag = zin_in_play_eindil }
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead }
		}
	}
}
